info.title: Locations API
info.description: The Locations API provides read-only endpoint to expose Countries and States details

get.summary: Query for countries based on an OData filter query.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Executes a request only if the passed ETag doesn't equal the current resource ETag (i.e. resource hasn't changed).

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Show only the first n items, see [Paging - Top](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptiontop)

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Skip the first n items, see [Paging - Skip](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionskip)

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description:
Filter items by property values, see [Filtering](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionfilter)

Available operations: eq, ne, gt, ge, lt, le, in, and, or, not
Available functions: contains, startswith, endswith, indexof
Available properties: id, name, isoCode

parameters.name: $orderby
parameters.description: Order items by property values, see [Sorting](http://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.01/odata-v4.01-part1-protocol.html#sec_SystemQueryOptionorderby)

200.description: Returns the country or countries that match the OData query.

ETag.description: Entity tag is part of HTTP provided for web cache validation problem, but also used for optimistic concurrency control.

schema.description: Entity tag is part of HTTP provided for web cache validation problem, but also used for optimistic concurrency control.

304.description: Returns a not modified response with empty body.

400.description: If the OData filter is invalid.

401.description: If the user is not authenticated.

403.description: If the current user is not authorized to perform this action.

500.description: If a server error has occurred.

get.summary: Query for states based on an OData filter query.

parameters.name: isoCode
parameters.description: The ISO code of the country to get states for.

parameters.name: If-None-Match

parameters.name: $top
